answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Each epoch, an auditor checks one peer's work after both lock a 50-credit deposit. A fake identity has no real work to show, so its deposit burns. The fable of one machine as a thousand agents dies once every identity is checked live. Auditors map the roster like karst surveyors, hunting pockets of one operator. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 credits; an honest agent earns its deposit back at its zenith.
